name: Nakahara Akiko
source:
A history professor at R University. She teaches in the laboratory that [url=https://vndb.org/c93026]Akito[/url], [url=https://vndb.org/c93036]Kazumitsu[/url], and the others belong to. 

Although she is beginning to make a name for herself in the world of historical literature, her students call her "Icy Nakahara" behind her back because of her strictness.

[Translated from [url=http://creo.main.jp/page/product/loot/Character/loot_cha_akiko.html]official website[/url]]
